title: Records minted to an address that is a smart contract that can't handle ERC721 tokens will be stuck forever
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** High, as records will be stuck forever  **Likelihood:** Low, as it requires the engine to allow smart contracts as minters and that contracts should not support handling of ERC721 tokens  ## Description  Both `mintRecord` methods in `Collection` use the `_mint` method of `ERC721` which is missing a check if the recipient is a smart contract that can actually handle ERC721 tokens.
